title: canastra lanceolata
intro: Canastra lanceolata, commonly known as the Brazilian rosemary or rosemary of the savannah, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Canastra lanceolata include reducing fever, relieving cough, and treating respiratory issues, as well as its use in wound healing and as an antiseptic. Bioactive constituents of Canastra lanceolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
